Apply a bit of moisture to the tragus (front part of your ear).
Place the earpiece on your left tragus, with the cable over and behind your ear.
Turn it on and slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling sensation. 
Use it for 30–60 minutes per day, ideally in the morning or split into morning and evening sessions. You can read, work, meditate, or relax while using it. 
Adjust the intensity if the sensation changes so it stays comfortable and pleasant.
